deck.name: Recent General Knowledge
deck.description: Notable events, science, sport, culture, and world affairs from 2022–2026, with years named in context.

questions.prompt: NASA’s DART spacecraft deliberately impacted Dimorphos in 2022 to test asteroid deflection.
questions.explanation: NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test intentionally impacted Dimorphos on September 26, 2022.

questions.prompt: Which NASA mission returned a sample from asteroid Bennu in 2023?
questions.explanation: NASA’s OSIRIS-REx capsule landed in Utah in September 2023 carrying material collected from Bennu.
questions.answer: OSIRIS-REx. Its capsule landed in Utah in September 2023 with material collected from Bennu.

questions.prompt: Which Indian mission made a successful soft landing near the Moon’s south polar region in August 2023?
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-3’s Vikram lander soft-landed on August 23, 2023.

questions.prompt: What was the name of NASA’s uncrewed lunar flight test launched in November 2022?
questions.explanation: Artemis I tested the Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft on an uncrewed trip around the Moon.
questions.answer: Artemis I, an uncrewed test of the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.

questions.prompt: China’s Chang’e-6 mission returned the first samples collected from the Moon’s far side in 2024.
questions.explanation: Chang’e-6 returned material from the lunar far side in June 2024, the first mission to do so.

questions.prompt: Which European Space Agency telescope released its first full-color cosmic images in November 2023 to study the dark universe?
questions.explanation: ESA’s Euclid mission released its first full-color images on November 7, 2023, beginning a survey of galaxies and cosmic structure.

questions.prompt: The path of totality for the April 8, 2024 total solar eclipse crossed Mexico, the United States, and Canada.
questions.explanation: The path of totality for the April 8, 2024 total solar eclipse crossed Mexico, the United States, and Canada.

questions.prompt: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics recognized work foundational to which field?
choices: Machine learning and artificial neural networks
questions.explanation: John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton received the 2024 Physics Prize for discoveries and inventions enabling machine learning with artificial neural networks.

questions.prompt: The 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognized computational protein design and what other achievement?
questions.explanation: David Baker was recognized for computational protein design; Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein structure prediction.

questions.prompt: Which technology did the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine honor for enabling effective mRNA vaccines against COVID-19?
questions.explanation: Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman were recognized for discoveries on nucleoside base modifications that enabled effective mRNA vaccines.

questions.prompt: Which pair received the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics for experiments with entangled photons and Bell inequalities?
choices: Alain Aspect, John Clauser, and Anton Zeilinger
questions.explanation: The 2022 Physics Prize was shared by Alain Aspect, John Clauser, and Anton Zeilinger for experiments on entangled photons and Bell inequality violations.

questions.prompt: Who won the 2023 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: The Swedish Academy awarded the 2023 Literature Prize to Norwegian author Jon Fosse.

questions.prompt: Which organization received the 2022 Nobel Peace Prize jointly with Ales Bialiatski and Memorial?
choices: International Committee of the Red Cross
questions.explanation: The 2022 Peace Prize was shared by Ales Bialiatski, Russia’s Memorial, and Ukraine’s Center for Civil Liberties.

questions.prompt: Which national team defeated England in the final of the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup?
questions.explanation: Spain defeated England 1–0 in the final of the 2023 tournament, co-hosted by Australia and New Zealand.

questions.prompt: Which two countries co-hosted the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup?
questions.explanation: Australia and New Zealand jointly hosted the 2023 tournament.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2024 Summer Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: Paris hosted the 2024 Summer Olympics, exactly 100 years after it previously hosted in 1924.

questions.prompt: Which country won the men’s UEFA Euro 2024 tournament?
questions.explanation: Spain defeated England 2–1 in the final and won a record fourth European Championship title.

questions.prompt: Which country won the 2024 Copa América men’s football tournament?
questions.explanation: Argentina defeated Colombia in the final after extra time to win the 2024 Copa América.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2024 United Nations climate conference, COP29?
questions.explanation: COP29 was held in Baku, Azerbaijan, in November 2024.

questions.prompt: The COP28 global stocktake called for a transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems.
questions.explanation: The COP28 global stocktake called for transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly, and equitable manner.

questions.prompt: What was the theme of Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai?
choices: Designing Future Society for Our Lives
questions.explanation: Expo 2025 in Osaka used the theme “Designing Future Society for Our Lives.”

questions.prompt: Which field did the United Nations name for its 2025 International Year?
questions.explanation: The UN designated 2025 the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology.

questions.prompt: Which 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry recognized the development of metal-organic frameworks?
questions.explanation: Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar Yaghi shared the 2025 Chemistry Prize for developing metal-organic frameworks.

questions.prompt: Which subject was named for a United Nations International Year in 2026?
questions.explanation: The UN designated 2026 as the International Year of the Woman Farmer.

questions.prompt: Which organization joined the G20 as a permanent member in 2023?
questions.explanation: The African Union became a permanent G20 member at the 2023 New Delhi summit.

questions.prompt: Which country joined NATO in 2023?
questions.explanation: Finland became NATO’s 31st member on April 4, 2023.

questions.prompt: Which country joined NATO in March 2024?
questions.explanation: Sweden became NATO’s 32nd member on March 7, 2024.

questions.prompt: In May 2023, WHO ended COVID-19’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern status while noting the disease remained a health threat.
questions.explanation: WHO said COVID-19 no longer constituted a PHEIC; it also emphasized that the disease remained an ongoing health threat.

questions.prompt: Which annual international climate agreement process held its 30th Conference of the Parties in Belém in 2025?
questions.explanation: COP30 under the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change took place in Belém, Brazil, in 2025.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2025 G20 leaders’ summit?
questions.explanation: South Africa held the G20 presidency and hosted the leaders’ summit in Johannesburg in 2025.

questions.prompt: Which film won Best Picture at the 2025 Academy Awards?
questions.explanation: Anora won Best Picture at the 97th Academy Awards in 2025.

questions.prompt: Which video game won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2023?
choices: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
questions.explanation: Baldur’s Gate 3 won Game of the Year at The Game Awards in December 2023.

questions.prompt: The 2022 Asian Games, held in 2023 after a delay, took place in which Chinese city?
questions.explanation: Hangzhou hosted the 2022 Asian Games in September and October 2023 after the event was postponed for a year.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games?
questions.explanation: Paris, France hosted the 2024 Paralympic Games after the Summer Olympics.
questions.answer: France hosted the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games.

questions.prompt: Which country won its second men’s T20 World Cup title in 2024?
questions.explanation: India beat South Africa in the final to win its second men’s T20 World Cup title.

questions.prompt: Which team defeated India in the final of the 2023 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup?
questions.explanation: Australia defeated India by six wickets in the final in Ahmedabad.

questions.prompt: Which team won Super Bowl LVIII, played in February 2024?
questions.explanation: Kansas City defeated San Francisco in overtime to win Super Bowl LVIII.

questions.prompt: Which two Italian hosts gave the 2026 Winter Olympics their official name?
questions.explanation: The Milano Cortina 2026 Games were staged across venues in northern Italy, including Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo.

questions.prompt: Which organization designates the International Years observed by the United Nations?
choices: United Nations through resolutions or its specialized agencies
questions.explanation: International Years are generally proposed by member states and established by a UN General Assembly resolution, or sometimes declared by a specialized agency.

questions.prompt: Which country’s mission Aditya-L1 entered a halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L1 point in January 2024?
questions.explanation: India’s Aditya-L1 solar observatory entered its halo orbit around the Sun–Earth L1 point on January 6, 2024.

questions.prompt: The World Meteorological Organization reported that 2023 was the warmest year in the instrumental record at that time.
questions.explanation: The WMO’s State of the Global Climate report confirmed 2023 as the warmest year then recorded, based on multiple datasets.

questions.prompt: Which two countries co-hosted the 2023 UN Water Conference?
questions.explanation: The conference was held at UN Headquarters in New York and co-hosted by Tajikistan and the Netherlands.

questions.prompt: Which team did Argentina defeat on penalties in the 2022 FIFA World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Argentina defeated France on penalties after a 3–3 draw in the final in Qatar.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2022 FIFA World Cup final?
questions.explanation: The final was played at Lusail Stadium, north of central Doha.

questions.prompt: By what score did South Africa defeat New Zealand in the 2023 Rugby World Cup final?
questions.explanation: South Africa won the final 12–11 in Paris.

questions.prompt: By how many runs did New Zealand defeat South Africa in the 2024 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: New Zealand won the final by 32 runs to claim its first Women’s T20 World Cup title.

questions.prompt: Which novel won the 2024 Booker Prize?
questions.explanation: Samantha Harvey’s Orbital won the 2024 Booker Prize.

questions.prompt: Which country won the 2025 Eurovision Song Contest?
questions.explanation: Austria won Eurovision 2025, hosted in Basel, Switzerland.

questions.prompt: Which organization adopted the Global Biodiversity Framework in 2022, including a target to conserve 30 percent of land and sea by 2030?
questions.explanation: The Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework was adopted under the Convention on Biological Diversity in December 2022.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2024 G20 leaders’ summit?
questions.explanation: Rio de Janeiro hosted the 2024 G20 leaders’ summit.

questions.prompt: Which country chaired the 2023 G20 leaders’ summit?
questions.explanation: India held the G20 presidency in 2023 and hosted the summit in New Delhi.

questions.prompt: Which name was given to the lunar lander that carried Japan’s SLIM spacecraft to the Moon in January 2024?
questions.explanation: JAXA’s SLIM mission achieved a lunar landing in January 2024 and demonstrated precision landing technology.

questions.prompt: What did the 2025 UN International Year of Glaciers’ Preservation draw attention to?
choices: The importance of glaciers and the effects of glacier loss
questions.explanation: The UN designated 2025 the International Year of Glaciers’ Preservation and March 21 as World Day for Glaciers.

questions.prompt: Which country won the 2025 ICC Champions Trophy in men’s cricket?
questions.explanation: India defeated New Zealand in the final to win the 2025 ICC Champions Trophy.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2025 ICC Champions Trophy final?
questions.explanation: The final was played in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after India’s matches were held at neutral venues.

questions.prompt: What was the score when Chelsea defeated Paris Saint-Germain in the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Chelsea won the final 3–0 at MetLife Stadium.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2025 World Athletics Championships?
questions.explanation: Tokyo hosted the 2025 World Athletics Championships at the National Stadium.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2025 United Nations Ocean Conference alongside Costa Rica?
questions.explanation: France and Costa Rica co-hosted the third UN Ocean Conference in Nice in June 2025.

questions.prompt: Which country held the 2025 presidency of the Council of the European Union during the second half of the year?
questions.explanation: Denmark held the rotating Council of the European Union presidency from July through December 2025.

questions.prompt: Which country retained the UEFA Women’s EURO title in 2025 after a penalty shootout?
questions.explanation: England beat Spain on penalties after the final ended level.

questions.prompt: What was the final score when England won the 2025 Women’s Rugby World Cup?
questions.explanation: England defeated Canada 33–13 in the final at Allianz Stadium.

questions.prompt: Which team did India defeat in the final of the 2025 ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup?
questions.explanation: India defeated South Africa in the final to win its first Women’s Cricket World Cup.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2025 World Aquatics Championships?
questions.explanation: Singapore hosted the 2025 World Aquatics Championships.

questions.prompt: Which country won the 2026 World Baseball Classic?
questions.explanation: Venezuela defeated the United States 3–2 in the 2026 final to win its first World Baseball Classic title.

questions.prompt: Which country’s 2025 Nobel Peace Prize laureate María Corina Machado is from?
questions.explanation: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado received the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize.

questions.prompt: Which writer received the 2025 Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: The 2025 Literature Prize was awarded to Hungarian writer László Krasznahorkai.

questions.prompt: Which research area did the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine recognize?
questions.explanation: Mary Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi were recognized for discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance.

questions.prompt: Which 2025 Nobel laureates in Economic Sciences were recognized for explaining innovation-driven economic growth?
choices: Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James Robinson
Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt
questions.explanation: The prize was shared by Joel Mokyr and by Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt for work on innovation-driven growth and creative destruction.

questions.prompt: Which 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics recognized experiments with macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling in an electric circuit?
questions.explanation: John Clarke, Michel Devoret, and John Martinis received the 2025 Physics Prize for discoveries involving macroscopic quantum effects in electric circuits.

questions.prompt: Which city hosted the 2025 UN Climate Change Conference (COP30)?
questions.explanation: COP30 was held in Belém, Brazil, in November 2025.

questions.prompt: CAF’s Appeal Board ruled in March 2026 that Morocco was awarded the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final by forfeit.
questions.explanation: CAF’s Appeal Board overturned the on-field result and declared Senegal to have forfeited the final, awarding Morocco a 3–0 result; Senegal announced an appeal.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
choices: Canada, Mexico, and the United States
questions.explanation: The 2026 men’s FIFA World Cup was jointly hosted by Canada, Mexico, and the United States.

questions.prompt: The 2026 FIFA World Cup expanded the field from 32 teams to 48.
questions.explanation: The 2026 edition expanded the field from 32 to 48 national teams.

questions.prompt: Which country won the 2026 Winter Olympic men’s ice hockey gold medal?
questions.explanation: The United States defeated Canada in overtime in the men’s ice hockey final at Milano Cortina 2026.

questions.prompt: Which country hosted the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
questions.explanation: Glasgow, Scotland hosted the 2026 Commonwealth Games.

questions.prompt: Which country holds the G20 presidency in 2026?
questions.explanation: The United States holds the G20 presidency for 2026; the leaders’ summit is scheduled for later in the year.

questions.prompt: Which country is scheduled to host the 2026 United Nations climate conference, COP31?
questions.explanation: COP31 is scheduled for Antalya, Türkiye, from November 9 to 20, 2026.
